description: This file defines a Spring MVC Controller named LoginController that handles login, logout, access denied, and unauthorized page requests within the admin section of a web application.

classes.name: LoginController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing login and logout views and handling access denial scenarios in the admin interface.

methods.name: displayLogin
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the login page.

methods.name: displayDenied
methods.description: Handles GET requests for access denied, performs logout if authenticated, then shows login page.

methods.name: unauthorized
methods.description: Handles GET requests for unauthorized access page.
